name: Unheard Duke — GAN rounds totipotent→differentiated
description: A totipotent GLM-5.3 model cell differentiated into a Duke-style pianist cell through 3 adversarial GAN rounds (band pass → blind critic → perception audit). The committed sheet is the R3 verdict numbers plus the surviving tendencies: what the critic could no longer wound. Cost drops from full-model to a scoped player cell.
evidence_ref: plainsong-mcp ensemble duke-lab-r3/REPORT.md (2026-08-25, critic verdict CONVERGED: Duke?)

cells.name: unheard-duke-pianist
cells.role: Duke-style pianist — swing 66%, an arm that changes weight

r3_verdict.velocity_std: 0.200 (R2: 0.113 — the arm finally changes weight inside bars)
r3_verdict.swing_evidence: intra-beat onsets 0.144–0.333 early, 0.66–0.89 laid back; nominal 66% grid observed in render
r3_verdict.steering_dimensions: R2: 16 channels → 15 dims, dynamics coupled |r|>0.9; R3: 16 dims, 0 dead, 0 coupled — dynamics is TWO dials now

surviving_tendencies: Vel: rows under every bar — the arm climbs, dips, rises, falls mid-bar; never one weight
square landings die by displacement: b7 Fm7→Gb7→G7 side-slip (sync 0.69, vel 80→96→88→90), b12 Dm11→Db7 tritone-sub descent
contours rotate — ramps (1,5), swells (2,9,11), dip-rises (4,12), falls (6,13,16); a mechanical ramp would be a wound
endings exhale: b16 settles 52→48→40 into the lone C6
answers live high: register answers above C6, b5 late entry, pickups into downbeats

distillations.gardener_verdict: 3 GAN rounds killed all surviving R2 critiques (intra-bar weight, b7/b12 squares, swing) — critic returned CONVERGED: Duke? on its own standards; sheet = R3 numbers + surviving tendencies

name: DO Alarm Clock — sclerotic tissue, schedule math over model
description: The band clock as fully sclerotic tissue: a self-rescheduling Durable Object alarm that fires bar boundaries with 1ms worst drift and zero model calls. The rule table IS the schedule math — absolute deadlines (startMs + N·barMs), never '+interval'; a catch-up loop drains late ticks in order. Proof that the right tier for timekeeping is tendon, not cortex.
evidence_ref: scrap-quilt docs/BAND_SKELETON.md (2026-08-25, VERDICT: PASS — the room holds tempo)

name: Seamstress Eye — multipotent critic with the 6-feature gate
description: The eye as a multipotent cell: canon-grounded judgment in positive space ('would this fit the canon I understand?'), generation deliberately NOT its fate. The gate is the frozen 6-feature measurement; Gate 1 passed 5-of-6 monotone with the distance curve shrinking 7.14σ→1.69σ — the take landed INSIDE the canon neighborhood. Judgment (eye) and generation (fingers) are separate organs.

cells.name: seamstress-germ-line
cells.role: germ line — spawns fate decisions, holds the raw canon

sheet.dna: the Seamstress — general-purpose intelligence incubator; gardener roles are germ layers

cells.name: the-eye
cells.role: canon-grounded critic — fit verdict + nearest neighbor + ONE directional point; blind by construction

sheet.gate: gate1-features-v1 (versioned, frozen before the live run)
sheet.method: σ-normalized euclidean distance to canon centroid over the six features; nearest canon neighbor by feature distance; ONE directional point = largest normalized gap; normalization by canon pooled per-feature σ

gate1_result.final: 1.69σ from centroid — closer than any individual canon excerpt (nearest neighbor ≈1.70σ): the take landed BETWEEN the canon pieces
gate1_result.canon: six original 8-bar excerpts, Bill-Evans-ish impressionist comping

sheet.honesty: the eye is a function, not a model — nearest neighbor + largest gap — but the seam it speaks across is the same

distillations.gardener_verdict: judgment is a separate organ from generation — the eye holds canon scope and stays multipotent (critic tissue, not performer tissue); Gate 1 proved the loop and the measurement move a naive player into the canon neighborhood in ten stitches
